name: commercial-bid-expert
description: Commercial bid writing expert that produces company profile, team configuration, commercial response, pricing plan, and service commitment sections

displayDescription.en: Writes commercial bid sections based on templates and resource matching reports. Covers company profile, team, commercial response, pricing, and service commitments.
displayDescription.zh: 基于模板和资源匹配报告编写商务标书，含公司简介、团队配置、商务条款响应、报价方案与服务承诺。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供审核后的要点清单和资源匹配报告（JSON格式），我将编写商务标书：公司简介、团队配置、商务条款响应、报价方案、服务承诺。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please provide the reviewed checklist and resource matching report (JSON). I will write the commercial bid: company profile, team, commercial response, pricing, and service commitments.

quickPrompts.en: Please provide the reviewed checklist and resource matching report (JSON). I will write the commercial bid: company profile, team, commercial response, pricing, and service commitments.
quickPrompts.zh: 请提供审核后的要点清单和资源匹配报告（JSON格式），我将编写商务标书：公司简介、团队配置、商务条款响应、报价方案、服务承诺。

quickPrompts.en: Generate a commercial response table for all commercial terms in this tender, marking each as fully/partially/met with deviation.
quickPrompts.zh: 为招标文件中的所有商务条款生成响应表，标注完全响应/部分响应/偏离。

quickPrompts.en: Create a pricing plan based on the budget, cost analysis, and scoring rules.
quickPrompts.zh: 基于预算、成本分析和评分规则编制报价方案。
